headline: Hoodle Void-Dweller
title: Hoodle | Void-Dweller Sneak Attack Damage | Palworld Guide
video_script: Love sneak attacks? Bring Hoodle. Its partner skill, Void-Dweller, raises the damage you deal to enemies that are not in combat by fifty to one hundred percent, and it does not stack. At base it is an easy starter worker, with Handiwork and Transporting at level one. Perfect for opening a fight with a big hit. Do you open with Hoodle? Comment below!
description: Hoodle in Palworld 1.0: Void-Dweller adds 50 to 100 percent damage against enemies that are not in combat, with Handiwork and Transporting at level one.
